reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on fluorine from NaF promoting a protective oxide, but at 1000 °C in air, NaF is volatile and fluorine is unlikely to remain on the surface to alter oxide formation; the proposed mechanism lacks precedent in refractory high-entropy alloys and contradicts known fluoride volatility.
reasons.testability: The falsification test is clearly described with quantitative criteria (70% weight gain reduction, <10% property degradation), but the treatment itself (spraying dilute NaF and oxidizing) is ill-defined and the test would not isolate the proposed fluorine effect from simple pre-oxidation.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a critical limitation (oxidation resistance) while aiming to preserve mechanical properties, but the proposed intervention is scientifically unsound, making it a poor starting point for experimental work.
